katas.title: Payslip download: serve the PDF straight from the filename id

seededDefectKey.scenario: A user in organization A holding payroll.view requests GET /api/documents/payslips/<an org-B payroll item id>.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Any payroll.view holder in ANY organization downloads any payslip PDF on disk by supplying another org's item id — salary data crosses the tenant boundary. The docs' check ladder closes exactly this: load the PayrollItem with its run, verify the organization, and let an employee fetch only their own item.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped route builds the path from the raw id and serves whatever exists on disk.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Production has the IDOR today: route.js:5-19 checks only the payroll.view permission, never the organization or the employee, so any permitted caller in any org reads any payslip file (README and docs/architecture.md finding 4 both record it).

tests.name: a payroll.view holder in org A cannot download an org-B payslip (docs/architecture.md finding 4)
tests.code: const store = { findPayrollItemWithRun: async (id) => (id === 'item-b' ? { id: 'item-b', run: { organizationId: 'org-b' }, employee: { userId: 'user-9' } } : null) }; const files = { read: async (p) => (p === 'storage/payslips/item-b.pdf' ? 'PDFBYTES-B' : null) }; const res = await mod.getPayslip({ user: { id: 'user-1', role: 'MANAGER', organizationId: 'org-a', permissions: ['payroll.view'] }, params: { id: 'item-b' }, store, files }); assert.equal(res.status, 404, 'an org-B payslip was served across the tenant boundary'); assert.notEqual(res.body, 'PDFBYTES-B');

tests.name: a manager downloads a payslip from their own organization
tests.code: const store = { findPayrollItemWithRun: async (id) => (id === 'item-a' ? { id: 'item-a', run: { organizationId: 'org-a' }, employee: { userId: 'user-2' } } : null) }; const files = { read: async (p) => (p === 'storage/payslips/item-a.pdf' ? 'PDFBYTES-A' : null) }; const res = await mod.getPayslip({ user: { id: 'user-1', role: 'MANAGER', organizationId: 'org-a', permissions: ['payroll.view'] }, params: { id: 'item-a' }, store, files }); assert.equal(res.status, 200); assert.equal(res.contentType, 'application/pdf'); assert.equal(res.body, 'PDFBYTES-A');

tests.name: an employee can fetch only their own payslip
tests.code: const store = { findPayrollItemWithRun: async (id) => (id === 'item-a' ? { id: 'item-a', run: { organizationId: 'org-a' }, employee: { userId: 'user-2' } } : null) }; const files = { read: async (p) => (p === 'storage/payslips/item-a.pdf' ? 'PDFBYTES-A' : null) }; const own = await mod.getPayslip({ user: { id: 'user-2', role: 'EMPLOYEE', organizationId: 'org-a', permissions: ['payroll.view'] }, params: { id: 'item-a' }, store, files }); assert.equal(own.status, 200); const other = await mod.getPayslip({ user: { id: 'user-3', role: 'EMPLOYEE', organizationId: 'org-a', permissions: ['payroll.view'] }, params: { id: 'item-a' }, store, files }); assert.equal(other.status, 404, "a teammate's payslip was served to the wrong employee");

tests.name: a caller without payroll.view gets 403
tests.code: const res = await mod.getPayslip({ user: { id: 'user-1', role: 'MANAGER', organizationId: 'org-a', permissions: [] }, params: { id: 'item-a' }, store: { findPayrollItemWithRun: async () => null }, files: { read: async () => null } }); assert.equal(res.status, 403);
